content: Browser Geolocation API coordinates are fundamentally spoofable client-side: DevTools location override, browser extensions (GeoSpoof etc.), and OS-level mock location apps on Android all feed fake coordinates to navigator.geolocation with no browser-side tamper flag. Android's native mock-location detection (LocationManager.isFromMockProvider) is unavailable to web pages. No web-only technique can cryptographically prove GPS authenticity; best mitigation is defense in depth (geofence radius check + photo + timestamp + server-side plausibility checks e.g. impossible travel speed between consecutive check-ins) rather than treating GPS as unforgeable proof.
